(indisetron) Profile Indisetron is a 5-HT3-receptor antagonist with general properties similar to those of ondansetron (p.1756); it is also stated to be an antagonist at 5-HT4 receptors. Indisetron hydrochloride is used as an antiemetic in the management of nausea and vomiting as- sociated with chemotherapy.
